targets.expr:
(
    (
      sum(irate(ig_route_request_total{router="gateway._router", route="29-v1-bindingLevel0", job="ig"}[1m]))
    )
 
    +
 
    (
      sum(irate(ig_route_request_total{router="gateway._router", route="30-v1-unbindingLevel0", job="ig"}[1m]))
    )
 
    -
 
    (
      sum(irate(ig_route_response_status_total{router="gateway._router", route="29-v1-bindingLevel0",family=~"server_error", job="ig"}[1m]))
    )
 
    -
 
    (
      sum(irate(ig_route_response_status_total{router="gateway._router", route="30-v1-unbindingLevel0",family=~"server_error", job="ig"}[1m]))
    )
) * 100
 
/
 
(
    (
      sum(irate(ig_route_request_total{router="gateway._router", route="29-v1-bindingLevel0", job="ig"}[1m]))
    )
 
    +
 
    (
      sum(irate(ig_route_request_total{router="gateway._router", route="30-v1-unbindingLevel0", job="ig"}[1m]))
    )
)

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(datetime) as time_sec,
  sum(trx) as value,
  '502' as metric
FROM ciam_sms_gateway_splunk_all FORCE INDEX (datetime_host)
WHERE datetime >= $__timeFrom()
AND datetime <= $__timeTo()
and httpRequestPath ='iam/v1/realms/tsel/authenticate'
and httpRequestHeader ='otp'
and statuscode = '502'
and maxrt > 5000
group by datex,timex
